title: MAOYU: Archenemy and Hero "Be Mine, Hero!" "I Refuse!"
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The Hero reaches the Demon Queen's castle only to find she wants his help: she argues the human-demon war has propped up human economies and that a sudden peace would bring worse bloodshed. The two join forces to end the war by reshaping society with new crops, technology and knowledge. A manga adaptation of Mamare Touno's web novel, released digitally in English.
life_message: Knowledge, economic reform and cooperation across enemy lines build a more lasting peace than victory in battle.
